methodology: Read the public index and candidate detail pages; verify the page heading rather than the common-name link alone. Store brief original factual summaries and source links, not mirrored pages or images. Located means a source lead, not final botanical or medical clearance. No new AI-provider calls or database writes were made.

publicObservation.scope: Public endpoint only; not a new private all-state Neon snapshot.

primaryChecks.finding: Human case series reports toxic eye injury following exposure to Annona squamosa seed material. Do not turn historical seed applications into beginner procedures.
NCCIH distinguishes juice from roots, stems and peel, which can be harmful in large amounts; safety for other parts during pregnancy or breastfeeding is poorly established.
A human case series links concentrated Averrhoa bilimbi juice ingestion to oxalate-related acute kidney injury; do not recommend medicinal juice consumption.
National Kidney Foundation advises people with kidney disease to avoid starfruit because of serious toxicity.
Piper nigrum belongs to Piperaceae; the StuartXchange Paminta heading says Arecaceae. Do not copy that family label.
Abutilon indicum belongs to Malvaceae; the StuartXchange Malbas heading says Myrtaceae. Do not copy that family label.
Ziziphus jujuba (L.) Gaertn. is a synonym of Ziziphus mauritiana var. mauritiana. This does not license transferring a page explicitly headed Ziziphus jujuba Mill.
